text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired for service hosted-inference (sev: P2)
alert: PD-8721
summary: 95p latency > 1200ms for /v1/generate in us-west1
link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8721
primary: @omar (oncall)
auto-escalate in 5m if unacknowledged
impacted: several production customers seeing increased tail latency and retries

[pause — no ack from primary]

incidentbot: Escalation: paging secondary @lina — primary unacknowledged for 5m

pagerduty: PD escalation triggered: secondary assigned -> @lina; manager escalation window = 12m

lina: ack — jumping on it. quick checks first:
```
kubectl -n infra get hpa inference-pool -o wide
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=inference --tail=200 | grep "95th_latency"
```
seeing worker queue backlog + HPA not scaling (pods at 100% CPU), a few OOMs on xsvc-2

lina: restarting worker pool in us-west1 now -> `ci ops restart inference-worker --region=us-west1`

incidentbot: Manager escalation will fire in 12m if no mitigation recorded. paging manager @kevin per policy

kevin: on call, joining. drop bridge link and any short tl;dr please. happy to authorize rollback if needed

lina: restart finished. preliminary metrics: `95p_latency 1250ms -> 210ms`, backlog 12k -> 300. no new OOMs.
Rolling a small config patch to reduce prefetch windows to avoid overload: `git push && ci deploy --canary=10%`

lina: monitoring — metrics are stable for 6m across us-west1. continuing to watch for error spikes

omar: sorry missed this, phone DND. acking now but looks like lina already mitigated. thanks for the quick response :clap:

kevin: nice work. keep an eye for 10m then stand down if steady. @omar please check autoscaler thresholds tomorrow (follow-up ticket)

incidentbot: PD incident PD-8721 marked resolved — metrics stable for 15m, no ongoing customer impact.
